item.title: Marginalia Search, Money, C++, Rust, AI, Stuff
Models Can Communicate via Inference Servers Despite Being Sandboxed
Gemini refused to give me the lyrics to Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
item.description: Both times it started outputting the lyrics, then stopped, retracted it and spat out the message you see here. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
item.description: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 Aims to Make Robots Safer, More Dexterous, and Faster Learners
item.description: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action (VLA) model designed to improve robots' dexterity, reliability, and learning speed, while enabling safer operation in unstructured real-world environments. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: DoorDash Scales Dispatch 10x While Maintaining 99.99% Peak Availability
item.description: DoorDash has redesigned its real-time dispatch platform, replacing a monolithic optimization engine with a distributed architecture that separates coordination from computation. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: Learning Out Loud (Under Near-Existential Pressure)
item.description: Laura Savino discusses the psychological friction of AI adoption for senior engineers & architects. She explains how shifting from static expertise to learning in public lowers anxiety, accelerates tooling fluency, and prevents burnout. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: QCon San Francisco 2026: Automating Spark Upgrades with Codex Agents at OpenAI
item.description: At QCon San Francisco 2026, Mouli Mukherjee, Engineering Manager for Data Infrastructure at OpenAI, argued that AI agents are most useful not for rebuilding a data platform, but for the open-ended operational work that is hard to turn into… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Dutch data protection authority advises against purchasing AI camera glasses
item.description: related: Nearby Glasses (smart glasses detector android app) Comments (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: QCon San Francisco 2026: Securing AI Agents in Production
item.description: At QCon San Francisco, Google's Amanda Walker framed AI agents as an insider-risk problem operating at machine speed, and described identity, credential and containment patterns for running them safely in production. By Mark Silvester (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Data Processing Incidents on Inference Providers
item.description: OpenRouter off-boarded three providers, removed 125 endpoints from Zero Data Retention eligibility, and notified potentially affected customers after canary token research on inference providers. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Podcast: Simulation Can Tell You What Your Agents are Actually Doing: A Conversation with Zhou Yu
item.description: Michael Stiefel spoke to Zhou Yu about using dynamic simulations to evaluate AI agents. (1 source: infoq)
